title: Ligation Sequencing Kit: Adapter Ligation and Clean-Up
author: Opentrons
materials: Pause and Spin Down the samples.

steps.title: Add master mix to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the prepared master mix into each well of the PCR plate and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Transfer samples to MIDI plate
steps.instruction: Move the sample reactions from the Sample PCR plate to the corresponding wells of the MIDI plate positioned on the Magnetic Module.

steps.title: Resuspend AMPure beads and transfer
steps.instruction: Pipette‑mix the AMPure beads to resuspend them, then transfer the bead suspension to the MIDI plate on the Magnetic Module.

steps.title: Pause for Hula mixer spin‑down
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol, place the plate on the Hula Mixer, and spin down the contents.

steps.title: Engage magnet and remove supernatant (first time)
steps.instruction: Engage the Magnetic Module for 5 minutes to pellet the beads, then remove the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Wash beads with fragment buffer
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate fragment buffer (Long or Short) to the beads, mix, re‑engage the magnetic module to pellet, wait as needed, and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Repeat bead wash
steps.instruction: Perform a second wash identical to the previous step.

steps.title: Pause for spin‑down before elution
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and spin down the samples again.

steps.title: Engage magnet briefly and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Place the plate on the magnetic module, engage the magnet for 1 minute, then remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Add elution buffer
steps.instruction: Disengage the magnet and add 15 µL of elution buffer to each well.

steps.title: Incubate elution
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature for 10 minutes to allow DNA to elute.

steps.title: Engage magnet to clear eluate
steps.instruction: Re‑engage the magnetic module for 5 minutes to pellet the beads, leaving a clear eluate.

steps.title: Replace PCR plate on Slot 2
steps.instruction: Pause, remove the old Bio‑Rad PCR plate from Slot 2, and replace it with a fresh Bio‑Rad PCR plate.

steps.title: Transfer eluate to new PCR plate
steps.instruction: Transfer 15 µL of the cleared eluate (new NDA library) into the corresponding wells of the new Bio‑Rad PCR plate.
